text:
Anya: thinking out loud — proposal for a new console UX: a 'soft-cut' fallback mode that gradually degrades responses instead of full model swap. idea is to reduce visible failures during rollouts. :thinking:
Mike: hm what does 'gradually' mean here? partial tokens or shorter responses?
Anya: two levers: 1) preserve prefix+KV cache so ongoing chats don't restart; 2) when fallback triggers, switch to a low-cost quantized variant but also cap max output length and mark answers as 'truncated' in metadata. small UX badge explains "soft-cut".
Elaine: auditability question — we need deterministic breadcrumbs so operator can replay why soft-cut kicked in. retention for those breadcrumbs?
Anya: yes — attach an event with decision reasons (latency, error-rate, quota, region fallback) and a sampling id. keep 30d by default, opt-in extended retention.
Sam: API impact: how do we surface the 'truncated' flag? header? extra field in response? We should avoid breaking current clients.
Anya: add an optional top-level field `redwood.degrade_info` (nullable). default unset for backwards compat. SDKs will map to a typed field later.
Mike: telemetry — what metrics to surface on console dashboards? success-rate, p95 latency, percent of requests with degrade_info, and distribution of degrade reasons.
Anya: agreed. also want a small heatmap of degraded endpoints by model+route so product owners can see hotspots.
Elaine: operator flow — make it easy to 'peek' at degraded responses without unmasking PII. Need a scrubbed sample and an operator consent flow.
Sam: good call. also thinking about rollout logic: soft-cut should be an intermediary state between normal and full fallback. maybe a config like `{mode: normal|soft-cut|hard-fallback, threshold: X}`
Mike: +1. we should tie thresholds to multiple signals (5xx spike, tail latency, token budget burn).
Anya: UX wires: small pill near rollout selector that toggles soft-cut and shows current sampling rate + recent triggers. clicking opens a lightweight inspector with sample traces and reason tags.
Elaine: for audit logs we need an exportable CSV of triggers (time, route, reason, sample_id, operator_override).
Anya: ops override: allow an operator to pause soft-cut for a route for N minutes with an auditable comment. that action creates an event and an automatic rollback probe.
ops-bot: notice — new opt-in policy "soft-cut" created in sandbox. Use `/ops list-policies` to view.
Sam: edge case: what happens to streaming responses? if we switch to quantized variant mid-stream we might lose continuity.
Mike: plan: avoid mid-stream switches — only evaluate on request start. if tail latency rises mid-response, mark subsequent requests with degrade_info.
Anya: also want a simulation mode in console to run historical traces through soft-cut settings and show estimated user-visible regressions and cost delta.
Elaine: simulation needs to fake sampling semantics and scrub outputs. legal will want a report.
Sam: API naming nit: prefer `degrade_info` over `fallback` because it's broader. good.
Mike: implementation notes — runtime needs to expose a decision hook with payload `{route, model_version, latency, error_class, quota_state}` and return `action:{allow|soft_cut|fallback}` + metadata. keep small protobuf.
Anya: can a rollout rule reference soft-cut as a target? e.g., rollout 20% soft-cut then 80% normal?
Mike: yes, that'd be powerful for progressive experiments. we should prevent oscillation by adding hysteresis windows.
Elaine: operator experience: when they see a spike, show 'why soft-cut picked this route' with a simple causal chain and a single-click unwind (pause or escalate).
Sam: test plan: unit tests for decision hook, e2e simulation against historical traces, SDK tests for `degrade_info` mapping, and a small canary on internal traffic.
Anya: next steps: I'll prototype console pill + inspector mockups, Mike/infra to draft the decision hook proto, Elaine to draft audit export schema, Sam to prepare SDK backwards-compat plan.
Mike: I'll start proto sketch today.
Elaine: I'll take export schema, will ping legal once draft done.
Sam: SDK PR after proto is stable.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: ux/prototype -> staging at 2026-03-21T15:04Z :rocket:
Anya: thanks all — going to drop the mock screens into figma and share link here in a bit. :thumbsup:
